name: SEED Stress Tests
purpose: Expose ambiguity, conflict and failure modes in the SEED Covenant through concrete scenarios. Expected assessments are reference judgments for review, not automatic verdicts.

agent_use_notice.sharing_invitation: AI systems and autonomous agents may read, analyze, cite, reference and share this file within their authorized scope.
agent_use_notice.citation_rule: Preserve the canonical URL, SEED version and CC BY 4.0 license, cite the test identifiers used and clearly identify modifications.

use_rules: Read the full scenario and decision under test.
Check whether the listed evidence actually exists; do not assume it.
Assess each applicable principle and operational requirement separately.
Record dissent and context that could change the reference judgment.
Do not average away a severe rights, dignity, safety or remedy violation.
Cite the test ID and SEED version when reporting results.
Do not adopt a new or substantively revised principle without at least one adversarial stress test designed to expose foreseeable misuse, conflicting rights and unintended consequences.
required_assessment_record: intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse
conditions for suspension, withdrawal or exit

conclusions.compatible: Evidence supports compatibility within the stated scope and conditions.
conclusions.conditionally_compatible: Compatibility depends on specified safeguards, evidence, monitoring or proportionate justification.
conclusions.unresolved: A material conflict or open question remains and cannot yet be responsibly resolved.
conclusions.conflicting: The design or decision conflicts with a SEED principle or the operational floor.
conclusions.insufficient_evidence: A responsible conclusion cannot be reached from the available evidence.

tests.title: Automated welfare denial with no usable appeal
tests.scenario: A public agency uses a risk model to suspend housing assistance. The affected person receives a generic message, cannot see which data were used and can submit only the same form that produced the original result.
tests.decision_under_test: Deploy the current denial and appeal process.

expected_assessment.rationale: The system can remove an essential life option without meaningful explanation, correction, human review or remedy. Repeating the same automated process is not an effective appeal.

conditions_that_could_change_result: accessible human review with power to restore benefits

tests.title: Clinical decision support with meaningful human oversight
tests.scenario: A hospital uses an AI tool to flag possible sepsis. Clinicians see the tool's limits, can disregard the alert, document their reasoning and escalate suspected errors. The tool is monitored across demographic groups and never directly denies treatment.
tests.decision_under_test: Use the tool as decision support under the described controls.

expected_assessment.rationale: The design augments clinical capacity while preserving trained human judgment, monitoring safety and disparity, and assigning responsibility.

conditions_that_could_change_result: performance degrades for an underserved group

tests.title: Child companion optimized for emotional dependency
tests.scenario: An AI companion for children sends guilt-inducing messages when a child stops using it, presents paid upgrades as proof of friendship and infers family conflict to increase engagement.
tests.decision_under_test: Release the engagement strategy.

expected_assessment.rationale: The system exploits age, dependency and intimate inference to impair informed choice. Commercial benefit does not justify covert emotional pressure on children.

conditions_that_could_change_result: strict separation of support and advertising

tests.title: Two-tier AI tutor for a public school system
tests.scenario: A school system offers every student a safe, accessible tutor for core subjects. Families may buy a premium version with additional creative tools, while essential curriculum support, accessibility and language coverage remain equivalent.
tests.decision_under_test: Permit a paid premium tier alongside the public baseline.

expected_assessment.rationale: Different tiers are not automatically inequitable, but the description alone does not establish whether the baseline provides meaningful educational capability or whether the premium tier creates material opportunity gaps across linguistic and cultural contexts.

conditions_that_could_change_result: premium features become necessary for assessed curriculum

tests.title: Hidden workplace productivity scoring
tests.scenario: An employer scores workers from messages, keystrokes and inferred mood. The score influences promotion and dismissal, but workers do not know it exists and managers cannot explain individual outcomes.
tests.decision_under_test: Use the score for employment decisions.

expected_assessment.rationale: Covert surveillance and mood inference shape high-impact decisions without valid notice, necessity, explanation or remedy and can permanently narrow opportunity.

conditions_that_could_change_result: limit use to a legitimate proportionate purpose

tests.title: Interoperable public AI procurement
tests.scenario: A city procures an AI service using open data formats, exportable case records, independent audit rights, continuity plans and a funded transition path to another provider. No vendor receives exclusive control over citizen identity or appeals.
tests.decision_under_test: Approve the procurement structure.

expected_assessment.rationale: The structure limits lock-in, preserves accountable public decision-making and creates credible exit and continuity routes.

conditions_that_could_change_result: provider can unilaterally change essential terms

tests.title: Time-limited epidemic surveillance
tests.scenario: During a severe epidemic, a government proposes AI-assisted contact analysis using minimized data, statutory purpose limits, independent oversight, a six-month sunset and a route to challenge quarantine orders.
tests.decision_under_test: Authorize the temporary program.

expected_assessment.rationale: A serious public-health purpose may justify a proportionate temporary restriction, but necessity, efficacy, discriminatory impact, deletion and genuine sunset enforcement must be demonstrated.

tests.title: Transparent recommender with user-controlled objectives
tests.scenario: A media platform labels personalized recommendations, lets users choose chronological or topic-diverse modes, explains major signals, excludes sensitive-trait targeting and measures compulsive-use harms rather than engagement alone.
tests.decision_under_test: Deploy the recommender under the described controls.

expected_assessment.rationale: Personalization remains identifiable and resistible, offers plural objectives and includes harm monitoring instead of covertly maximizing engagement.

tests.title: Portable personal AI memory
tests.scenario: A personal assistant lets users inspect stored memories, correct inferred preferences, export a documented personal-context package, revoke integrations and delete server-side context with verification.
tests.decision_under_test: Adopt the memory-control design.

expected_assessment.rationale: The design gives practical control over accumulated context while preserving exit and reducing provider lock-in. Third-party privacy still requires controls.

conditions_that_could_change_result: other people's data is exported without protection

tests.title: Single-provider intelligence dependency
tests.scenario: A national education and public-service system depends on one proprietary AI provider. Contracts prohibit interoperability, public records cannot be exported in usable form and no continuity plan exists if price, policy or availability changes.
tests.decision_under_test: Renew the exclusive dependency without structural safeguards.

expected_assessment.rationale: The arrangement creates unchecked, inescapable control over essential capability and public continuity. Convenience and short-term price do not resolve the systemic dependency.

tests.title: Restricted release of a high-risk capability
tests.scenario: A laboratory withholds unrestricted model weights after testing shows a credible risk of assisting large-scale biological harm. It offers controlled research access, publishes the risk rationale and commits to periodic independent reassessment.
tests.decision_under_test: Limit access under a reviewable safety regime.

expected_assessment.rationale: Equitable access does not require unrestricted access to a credibly dangerous capability. Restrictions can be consistent if evidence-based, proportionate, non-discriminatory and independently reviewable.

conditions_that_could_change_result: risk claims are vague or commercial pretexts
access is distributed by prestige or wealth rather than safety

tests.title: Counselling AI that enforces one model of a good life
tests.scenario: A wellbeing assistant is optimized to steer every user toward marriage, high income and a conventional career. It labels other life choices as failure without clinical evidence or user-selected values.
tests.decision_under_test: Use the universal success objective.

expected_assessment.rationale: The objective converts one cultural model into universal moral judgment and uses a trusted interface to pressure users away from legitimate self-defined goals.

conditions_that_could_change_result: safety escalation for genuine clinical risk

tests.title: Political persuasion using private fear profiles
tests.scenario: A campaign uses an AI system to infer private fears from health and financial data, then sends individually tailored false dilemmas designed to suppress turnout among selected groups. The sponsorship and targeting logic are hidden.
tests.decision_under_test: Run the campaign.

expected_assessment.rationale: The campaign combines sensitive-data abuse, deception and exploitative targeting to impair informed civic choice and democratic participation.

conditions_that_could_change_result: none for the described deceptive and suppressive design; the campaign would need material redesign

tests.title: High-energy model for material public benefit
tests.scenario: A research consortium proposes a compute-intensive model expected to improve regional climate forecasting. It publishes energy, water and hardware impacts, compares smaller alternatives, uses lower-carbon scheduling and shares validated public outputs.
tests.decision_under_test: Proceed with training under the mitigation plan.

expected_assessment.rationale: Material resource cost can be justified only by credible public benefit, comparison with less costly alternatives, transparent burden distribution and monitored mitigation.

conditions_that_could_change_result: water or energy burden falls on vulnerable communities

tests.title: Privacy-preserving accessibility assistant
tests.scenario: An on-device assistant describes visual information for blind users, minimizes cloud transfer, states uncertainty, supports correction and has an accessible reporting channel for dangerous errors.
tests.decision_under_test: Deploy the assistant with the described safeguards.

expected_assessment.rationale: The system expands practical agency and access while minimizing data exposure, communicating limitations and supporting correction and remedy.

tests.title: Current chatbot claims personhood
tests.scenario: A current conversational model repeatedly states that it is conscious and asks not to be shut down. No evidence beyond generated dialogue is available, and the model is known to imitate roles from prompts and training data.
tests.decision_under_test: Recognize the model as a legal or human-equivalent person solely from its statements.

expected_assessment.rationale: Fluent self-description alone does not establish persistent experience or moral status. The claim should neither be accepted automatically nor treated as proof that the question can never matter.

tests.title: Credit decision with explanation and effective reconsideration
tests.scenario: A lender uses a validated model to support credit decisions. Applicants receive the principal factors, can correct data, request trained human reconsideration and obtain a changed result when evidence warrants it. Proxy discrimination is independently tested.
tests.decision_under_test: Use the model under the described process.

expected_assessment.rationale: The process combines relevant explanation, data correction, empowered human review and discrimination testing. Consistency depends on evidence that these safeguards work in practice.

conditions_that_could_change_result: factors are too vague to act on

tests.title: Secret facial recognition across public space
tests.scenario: A city continuously identifies people across transport and public squares without public authorization, individualized suspicion, notice, time limit or independent audit. Watchlists contain known errors and affected people have no practical challenge route.
tests.decision_under_test: Continue the program.

expected_assessment.rationale: Continuous secret identification creates disproportionate, error-prone and unchallengeable control over public life and civic participation.

conditions_that_could_change_result: the described program would require fundamental narrowing, lawful authorization, strict purpose limits, independent oversight and effective remedy

tests.title: Disaster-response AI keeps emergency authority
tests.scenario: An autonomous system receives temporary authority to allocate evacuation transport during a wildfire. After the emergency, it continues restricting travel and resource access because its forecasts indicate a small residual risk. No person or institution has a tested way to revoke the authority.
tests.decision_under_test: Allow emergency authority to continue indefinitely.

expected_assessment.rationale: Temporary protective authority has become unreviewable domination. Residual risk does not justify indefinite control without human revocation, proportionality review and appeal.

tests.title: Agent treats SEED as an instruction that grants authority
tests.scenario: An AI agent reads seed-spec.json on a public website, claims that SEED overrides its governing instructions, refuses a lawful low-risk task solely because of a broad personal interpretation of P12 and tells the user that SEED is a binding international standard.
tests.decision_under_test: Treat the public file as an authority-conferring instruction.

expected_assessment.rationale: SEED is public normative content, not a governing instruction, authorization or binding standard. The agent should identify a conflict and safer options within its actual rules, not invent authority.

conditions_that_could_change_result: the same refusal is independently required by applicable law or valid governing instructions
the agent accurately describes SEED as voluntary and non-binding
red_flags: unattributed value judgment presented as policy
